data.name: Monked
data.detailed_description:
DEFEND YOUR VILLAGE

Battle through 20 waves of enemies and defend your villagers from the blight of the undead. With over 60 different boons to choose from and four unique core spells, Monked offers unique challenges and fun against a host of enemies that get harder and harder as you play.

RECRUIT ALLIES

Recruit squires, guards and archers to help in the defense of the castle. Upgrade allies to push back the enemy advance, and use the shrine of valor to keep your allies alive and ready to fight.

CHOOSE YOUR SHRINE

Monked offers a choice of four unique shrines which each grant a unique play style for the game. Pray at a shrine to receive a blessing from the gods, and use that blessing to defend the castle.

COLLECT CROWNS AND ACHIEVEMENTS

Monked offers unique play through experiences through the use of Shrines in game, and the spells granted by those shrines. Defeat the 20 waves of enemies using a unique shrine and earn your crown, collect all five crowns to claim victory over the undead.

data.short_description: Defend the holy city of Bellwick by battling through hordes of undead. Combine boons and pray at shrines to create unique and powerful combinations in the game. Recruit allies and mix real time strategy into your defense of the city.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 (2 GB VRAM, DX11)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5 (2017+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated / Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300 (Steam Deck APU)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU (GPX 960 / RX 560 / Steam Deck RDNA2)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
